page: Amazon Web Services trn1.2xlarge is an accelerated computing instance powered by the AWS Nitro System, designed primarily for deep learning model training and inference. The host platform features an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, providing 8 virtual CPUs across 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. System memory comprises 32 GB of DDR4 RAM operating at 3 GHz, delivering an exact 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single AWS Trainium accelerator equipped with 32 GB of high-bandwidth device memory. In addition, the instance includes 474 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations show consistent midrange general-purpose compute metrics, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 6055.0 and a single-core score of 1634.0. PassMark CPU testing yielded 11329.27 points, complemented by Redis SET processing at 7.97 million operations per second and static web throughput of 12.21 GB/sec. Parallel decompression on bzip3 registered lower relative efficiency at 31.76 GB/sec in the lower quartile. In language model evaluations, small 135M parameter models achieved solid throughput at 566.23 tokens per second for prompt processing and 175.64 tokens per second for generation. However, CPU-bound execution on larger 7B models dropped significantly to 16.34 prompt tokens per second and 7.69 generation tokens per second, underscoring the necessity of compiling workloads to target the native Trainium accelerator cores directly.

The bundled 474 GB local NVMe SSD provides low-latency scratch space for training datasets, intermediate model checkpoints, and container layers. Given the accelerator allocation paired with moderate CPU resources, this instance offers a cost-effective development and deployment tier for deep learning engineering. It is appropriate for fine-tuning smaller architectures, ML model compilation validation, model inference pipelines, and distributed ML worker nodes.
description: Amazon Web Services trn1.2xlarge is an accelerated computing instance engineered for machine learning and deep learning workloads. Built on the AWS Nitro System, the instance features an Intel Xeon 8375C x86_64 processor clocked at 3.5 GHz with 8 vCPUs (4 physical cores) and 32 GB of DDR4 memory. Acceleration is provided by one AWS Trainium processor with 32 GB of accelerator memory, alongside a bundled 474 GB local NVMe SSD and 3 Gbps baseline networking. Compute benchmarks demonstrate solid mid-tier CPU throughput, recording a Geekbench score of 6055.0 and Redis SET speeds of 7.97 million operations per second. While host CPU performance falls off on unaccelerated 7B parameter model execution, the dedicated Trainium core provides specialized processing for targeted deep learning architectures. The trn1.2xlarge instance serves as an efficient configuration for ML model fine-tuning, inference serving, and distributed training development.
